== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original and later [[Program Trap (Errata)|Errata]] / [[Program Trap (PC Errata)|PC Errata]] articles of this family. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. Columns are Original · PC Errata (Appendix A) only. Glossary 2.0 has no replacement Card Text. Do not add Revised, Japanese, foil, or (V) columns. {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous filled cell. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
